Short title, extent and commencement

FACTORIES (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AMENDMENT) ACT,
1946
ACT No. VII OF 1947
[Received tote assent of the Governor
General on the 29th March, 1947.]
[29th March, 1947]
An Act to amend
the Factories Act, 1934, as applicable to the fort‑West Frontier Province.
1. Short title, extent and commencement. (1) This Act may be called
the Factories (North‑West Frontier Province Amendment) Act. 1946.
(2) Is shall extend to the whole
of the North‑West Frontier Province.
(3) It shall come into force on such date [i.e. 15 May 1947. Noti. 20733-D. L. 12 May
1947.] as the Provincial Govern ment may, by notification in the
Official Gazette, appoint in this behalf:

sections.shortTitle: Factories N -W F P Amendment Act 1946
sections.description:
Insertion of Section 5-A in Act XXV of 1934

FACTORIES (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AMENDMENT) ACT, 1946
FACTORIES (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AMENDMENT) ACT,
1946
ACT No. VII OF 1947
[Received tote assent of the Governor
General on the 29th March, 1947.]
[29th March, 1947]
An Act to amend
the Factories Act, 1934, as applicable to the fort‑West Frontier Province.
2. Insertion of Section 5‑A in Act XXV of 1934. After Section
5 of the Factories Act. 1934 (Arty. XXV of 1934) (hereinafter referred to as
the said Act) the following section shall be deemed to be it inserted, namely: ‑‑
53-A. [Added by N.W.F.P.
Act XI of 1948. s.2.]
[Establishment of factories].‑‑ (1) No factory shall be
established or extended for the purpose of carrying on one or more of the
manufacturing processes mentioned in the schedule to this Act, or for purposes
incidental thereto save with the permission in writing of the Provincial
Government or such person or persons as it may direct.
Provided that if an application
for such permission has been dispatched to the prescribed authority by
registered post acknowledgment due and the decision of Government or the
prescribed authority has not been com municated to the applicant for six months
after the date of its receipt the applicant shall be regarded as having
obtained that permission [Subs for the
original proviso, ibid s.3.] [and provided further that a factory shall
be deemed to be extended within the meaning of this section only when an
addition to the equipment made on a particular point of time brigs about
substantial increase in its capacity and not merely because of any renewal or
addition to existing, machinery or appliances within the limits prescribed.]
(2) Where any
order rejecting on application for the establishment or extension of a factory
has been made by an authority other than the Provincial Government an appeal by
the applicant shall lie to the Provincial Government within fifteen days of the
date on which such order has been, communicated to him.
(3) The
Provincial Government may, by notification in the official Gazette add to or
exclude front the schedule the name of any manufacturing process it may deem
fit, and such addition or exclusion shall take effect as it had been made by
this Act.
(4) Any person who contravenes
the provisions of sub‑section (1) above shall on conviction be punishable
with fine which may extend to 5,000 rupees and in addition, with fine which may
extend to 100 rupees for each day of the period during which the contravention
continues".
sections.punishment:
punishable
with fine which may extend to 5,000 rupees and in addition, with fine which may
extend to 100 rupees for each day of the period during which the contravention
continues".

sections.shortTitle: Factories N -W F P Amendment Act 1946
sections.description:
Insertion of Sections 9-A. and 9-B in Act XXV of 1934

FACTORIES (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AMENDMENT) ACT, 1946
FACTORIES (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AMENDMENT) ACT,
1946
ACT No. VII OF 1947
[Received tote assent of the Governor
General on the 29th March, 1947.]
[29th March, 1947]
An Act to amend
the Factories Act, 1934, as applicable to the fort‑West Frontier Province.
9‑A. [Added by N.W.F.P. Act XI of 1948, a.2.]
[Registration of factories].‑No factory [Added, ibid s. 4.] [for the purpose, of] carrrying on one or more of the
manufacturing processes in the schedule to this Act or for purpose incidental
thereto shall be worked or permitted to be worked by a Manager or an occupier
unless a registration certi ficate has been granted in respect thereof; and if
the factory has been. extended after the grant of a registration certificate,
unless such certificate has been endorsed in such manner and subject to such
conditions as may be‑prescribed for the grant of such a certificate or
for an. endorsement thereon.
(2) A registration certificate
granted under sub‑section (1) shall remain in force for one year from the
date of the grant or, endorsement and shall be renewable automatically on
payment of the prescribed fee.
9‑B.
Rules.‑---(1) The Provincial Government may, after previous publi cation
in the official Gazette, make rules relating to all or any of the matters
mentioned below:‑
(a) as the authority by whom, the form in
which and the conditions, subject to which, a registration certificate may be
granted or an endorsement made under sub‑section (I) of section 9‑A;
(b) prescribing the fee on payment of which
a registration certificate may be granted or renewed or an endorsement made
under section 9‑A ;
(c) specifying the limit within which any
renewal of or addition to existing machinery or appliance in a factory shall
not be regarded as extention of a factory within the meaning of section 5‑A
(1) ; and
(d) specifying the persons or persons to
whom authority may be delegated under section 5‑A (1).
(2) In making rules the
Provincial Government may prescribe different rates of fees for factories
classified according to the number of workers employed in them and the nature
of goods produced by them.

1946
ACT No. VII OF 1947
[Received tote assent of the Governor
General on the 29th March, 1947.]
[29th March, 1947]
An Act to amend
the Factories Act, 1934, as applicable to the fort‑West Frontier Province.
4. Insertion of section 62‑A in Act XXV of 1934.‑‑--After
section 62 of the said Act, the following section shall be deemed to be
inserted, namely :‑
"62‑A. Penalty for failure to
register: ----‑A manager or an occupier who contravenes the provision
of section 9‑A or the conditions on which a registration certificate is
granted or an endorsement made shall be punishable with fine which may extend
to five hundred rupees, or, if he has previously been convicted of offence
under that section of the said Act, to one thousand rupees on the second
conviction. For every subsequent offence the maxi mum amount of fine which may
be imposed shall be enhanced by five hundred rupees subject to a maximum of two
thousand rupees."
